Podgornaia2015_PhoQ.assay: Two-step selection for a functional PhoQ–PhoP interface in E. coli. PhoP-dependent YFP was used in low/high extracellular Mg conditions; variants were enriched after selection for WT-like activity and Mg-starvation survival.
Podgornaia2015_PhoQ.direction_basis: The primary paper calls variants enriched after the functional selection functional PhoQ variants; greater enrichment/fitness therefore indicates retained or stronger target function.
